messages:
jordan: FYI: published docs and SDK note about telemetry opt-in + new config file format. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459

maria: what's changing for customers?

jordan: Two things: 1) telemetry is now opt-in (RW_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=true). Previously we had a permissive opt-out flow; customers asked for explicit opt-in. 2) CLI config moves from ~/.redwood/config.yaml to ~/.config/redwood/config.toml (more cross-os friendly). We added migration helpers.

leo: Any breaking behavior?

jordan: No runtime breaking by default. But if someone relied on old config path, CLI will warn and auto-migrate for most setups. We will remove auto-migrate after 90 days.

maria: Can you paste the migration command snippet?

jordan: Sure:
```
# automatic migrate (recommended)
redwood-cli config migrate --from ~/.redwood/config.yaml

# manual example (toml)
[auth]
api_key = "${RW_API_KEY}"
[telemetry]
enabled = false
```

ops-bot: docs update: /sdk/config-migration published. CDN purge scheduled at 09:20 UTC.

leo: Will existing CI pipelines break because of the path change?

jordan: Most CI setups use env vars (RW_API_KEY) and won't be impacted. If CI mounts a repo with the old dotfile, the migrate command should be added to CI before the 90-day auto-migrate removal. We'll add a suggested CI snippet in the KB.

maria: Timeline for the opt-in enforcement?

jordan: Opt-in takes effect immediately (new installs default to telemetry disabled). For existing users we will keep current behavior for 60 days then switch to enforced opt-in with an explicit console banner prompting action. Full enforcement in ~120 days.

docs-bot: KB created: "Telemetry opt-in and config migration" https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459/files

jordan: Action items: @maria draft customer-facing note summarizing key changes and migration steps; @leo add CLI auto-migrate test and CI snippet; docs team to monitor support queue for 2 weeks. Thanks! :megaphone:
